target_model: Claim frequency per policy-year for motor policies (synthetic, M1-shaped)
formula: ClaimNb ~ VehPowerGLM + VehAgeGLM + DrivAgeGLM + BonusMalusGLM + DensityGLM + AreaGLM

prediction.units: expected claims over the policy's exposure

preprocessing.description: Vehicle power capped at 9, as a factor with reference 6
Cap vehicle age, driver age and bonus-malus

baseline_comparison.rationale: Pricing must beat a flat rate

subgroup_performance.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

stability.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

sensitivity.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

assumptions.rationale: Not needed for the parity fixture

baseline_r:
dat <- read.csv("inputs/policies.csv")
dat$AreaGLM <- as.integer(as.factor(dat$Area))
dat$VehPowerGLM <- as.factor(pmin(dat$VehPower, 9))
dat$VehPowerGLM <- relevel(dat$VehPowerGLM, ref = "6")
dat$VehAgeGLM <- pmin(dat$VehAge, 12)
dat$DrivAgeGLM <- pmin(dat$DrivAge, 80)
dat$BonusMalusGLM <- as.integer(pmin(dat$BonusMalus, 150))
dat$DensityGLM <- as.numeric(log(dat$Density))
set.seed(100)
ll <- sample(nrow(dat), round(0.8 * nrow(dat)))
learn <- dat[ll, ]
test <- dat[-ll, ]
glm1 <- glm(ClaimNb ~ VehPowerGLM + VehAgeGLM + DrivAgeGLM + BonusMalusGLM + DensityGLM + AreaGLM,
            family = poisson(), data = learn, offset = log(Exposure))
